items.text: Packers WR Christian Watson ruled out after evaluation for concussion following sideline hit by Rams S Kamren Kinchens (who was ejected); had earlier returned from thigh issue.
items.why: Concussion evaluation mid-game after hit; previously Q to return from thigh.
items.implication: Removes top GB WR mid-game and potentially longer; targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes for remaining GB WRs in two-minute and red zone.

items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) for TNF vs Bills; third straight miss, rookie Emmett Johnson starts again.
items.why: Groin; DNP Wednesday after limited earlier; team announcement.
items.implication: Johnson continues as workhorse RB1 opportunity vs BUF.
items.opportunity: Full carries/snaps/routes for backup RB vs tough matchup.

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy DNP Wednesday with ankle sprain from SNF; Shanahan says day-to-day.
items.why: Low ankle sprain suffered Q2 vs MIN; no practice Wed.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 12 availability; potential backup impact if misses.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving this week: since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC average more PPG among RBs; gets Carolina matchup.
items.why: Elite recent PPG + soft CAR defense.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; prioritize in lineups.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share vs weak run D.

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten DNP Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries; resurfaces as concern, potential GTD.
items.why: Foot/ankle; did not practice; injury resurfaced in prior loss per ETR.
items.implication: Risk of limited or out; handcuff/backup elevated.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps for next man (e.g. Rodriguez) if inactive.

items.text: Levitan on Travis Etienne: could see disappointing snaps and routes down stretch but reasonably high carry count; strong playoff schedule vs ARZ/ATL Weeks 16/17. Cites Graziano.
items.why: Usage trends post-changes; carry floor remains while receiving role shrinks.
items.implication: RB2/flex floor via volume but capped ceiling without routes; hold for playoffs.
items.opportunity: Carry share floor + favorable late schedule.

items.text: Berry notes Derrick Henry target share jumped to 12% (4.5 rec/g) in 2 games with Brissett vs prior <6%/1.3; raises PPR floor significantly.
items.why: QB change increased receiving involvement.
items.implication: Higher floor as RB1/2 even if rushing fluctuates; LOVE for volume.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets + red-zone carries.

items.text: Berry highlights DeVonta Smith 57% target share Week 11; 36% avg in 5 games, 50% end-zone targets; role elite despite injuries tanking season.
items.why: Massive target concentration with Hurts out/injuries.
items.implication: WR1 upside if healthy; ride-or-die validation.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets/red-zone share.

items.text: ETR Week 12 preview: Puka Nacua and Terrance Ferguson out for season; Colts cut Jones with AR starting; Tuten injury resurfaces.
items.why: Confirmed season-ending injuries; roster moves.
items.implication: LAR WR/TE void; IND QB change; JAC RB caution.
items.opportunity: LAR targets to Adams/others; IND skill upside with AR; JAC backup.

items.text: Packers LB Micah Parsons officially active for GB-LAR after PUP activation and clearance.
items.why: Cleared and activated; Rapoport confirmed return.
items.implication: Boosts GB defense; no direct fantasy offensive impact.

items.text: Berry HATES Bo Nix this week: expects heavy Jonah Coleman run share vs PIT; insufficient rushing from Nix; outside top 20 QBs.
items.why: Run-heavy script projected; low dual-threat upside recently.
items.implication: Sit/stream elsewhere; fade in DFS cash.

items.text: Berry DOWNGRADES Jaylen Warren: since Dowdle return Week 6, only 51% rush attempts, <10% targets in 3/5, RB20 utilization; mid-low RB2.
items.why: Split with Dowdle reduces opportunity.
items.implication: Demote from fringe RB1; flex risk.

items.text: Berry DOWNGRADES D'Andre Swift: with Monangai back, 47% snaps/39% rushes in Week 11, <10% targets in 4/5 active games; mid-low RB2.
items.why: Committee with Monangai caps share.
items.implication: Not RB1; cautious start.

items.text: Berry on Ladd McConkey: season-high 38% target share in return, 20.7 pts; when >=20% share averages 17.5 PPG; solid if healthy.
items.why: Strong return usage after limited snaps earlier.
items.implication: WR2/3 with upside; monitor health.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share post-return.

items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker III for Thursday Night vs Bills due to groin injury; rookie Emmett Johnson to start for third straight game. Rapoport aligned.

items.implication: Full handcuff/backup elevation in high-scoring potential matchup; Walker ROS monitor.

items.opportunity: Full-season target/route share increase for remaining LAR WRs.
